verdict.rationale: Kimi is an AI assistant and API service, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack describes such an opt-out, a no-training policy, or any data-retention control. The docs cover coding features, models and API keys, and the community items discuss pricing, model quality and account sign-up, none of which concern training-data use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
